steps.title: two fingers, 3rd and 7th
steps.body:
Put one finger on the chord's 3rd and one on its 7th. On each change, move each finger to the nearest 3rd or 7th of the next chord: a half step, a whole step, or not at all.

In C major, `Dm7` to `G7`: F and C become F and B. C falls a half step to B, F stays.

A bar counts when you play both guide tones of its chord. The keys show chord tone, tension or avoid as you play. After the drill, the voice-leading map shows every move in the loop.
